subject: Weekly leadership snapshot: priorities, blockers, and delegated actions (Feb 2)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 15:18:00 +0000
Subject: Weekly leadership snapshot: priorities, blockers, and delegated actions (Feb 2)

Team —

Concise update ahead of the QBR prep this week. I kept this to bullets so folks can triage quickly.

WINS
- Hosted API latency edge cases: infra pushed the new kernel selection heuristic into prod; median p95 reduced ~12% for checkout flows.
- Sales: Acme POC converted to paid pilot (see deal id above). Kudos to the sales/solutions pairing.

RISKS / OPEN BLOCKERS
- Procurement hold for Acme Dedicated (contract redlines) — legal has flagged one data residency clause. Procurement contact at FinCo/Acme expects a response from our team by EOD Thu or they will pause the onboarding calendar.
- Capacity: Dedicated pool utilization is at 88% with one node draining for maintenance; if we get two concurrent large inferences we risk transient queuing for mid-tier customers.
- QBR deck draft: still missing clear customer ROI slide. Need concise cost-per-infer math and top-3 production examples.

ASKS (who / what / by when)
- Laura: can you take lead on the ROI slide and one short customer example (15–30s talking points)? Need first draft Wed COB. Attachment: QBR_prep_slide_deck_v3.pptx (slide 9 placeholder).
- Markus: escalate procurement redline with legal — please loop procurement@finco.com and push for a quick alternate clause. Response needed Thu EOD to keep onboarding schedule.
- Maya: run a 30-min capacity review with infra and ops tomorrow; share mitigations and whether we need temporary burst capacity. Schedule with Vivek and me.
- Vivek: review the mitigation plan and decide on temporary reserve by Thu morning.

Notes: I attached the current deck and the team capacity forecast. If you want a quick call, I can do a 20-minute sync at 16:30 UTC today.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Strategy Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments (stubs): QBR_prep_slide_deck_v3.pptx (pptx, 8.4 MB); team-capacity-forecast.xlsx (xlsx, 120 KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Weekly leadership snapshot: priorities, blockers, and delegated actions (Feb 2)

Thanks Jonas — good concise list. Quick replies inline.

> WINS — great on latency improvements. Can we capture a single callout for the deck showing before/after p95?
I will draft a one-slide ROI (cost per API call, sample customer uplift, and one quoted metric). Will pull the before/after p95 from infra metrics and put both in the slide. Target: Wed 18:00 UTC for first pass.

> PROCUREMENT HOLD — noted.
Markus — if legal provides an alternate clause, can we include suggested language that meets the compliance team's needs but removes the procurement roadblock? If you want, I can draft suggested phrasing for your review.

> CAPACITY 88% — Maya, please prioritize answers to: what is the expected headroom if two additional pilots (Acme + one mid-market) come online concurrently? Also include the estimated cost of a temporary node for a week.

Small ask: can someone add a one-line summary of customer feedback from the Acme pilot (technical fit + primary blocker) to the deck? That will help the narrative.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@finco.com
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 17:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Weekly leadership snapshot: priorities, blockers, and delegated actions (Feb 2)

Looping in procurement to speed this. Short update: legal flagged the data residency sentence because it currently mandates on-prem keys for logging; that is the primary blocker for Acme.

I propose two parallel moves:
1) Immediate: offer a short-term contractual carve-out for the pilot that limits retention + clarifies logging access (proposed language below).
2) Medium: engage Compliance to define a standard pilot-safe clause that we can reuse (reduces future friction).

Proposed quick wording (for legal to iterate): "For the duration of the pilot term, Customer agrees to data retention settings as mutually agreed, with logs retained for no longer than 30 days and accessible only for operational debugging by Redwood personnel under an NDA. This clause is intended as a limited operational exception and is not precedent for future production deployments."

If legal agrees to this language, procurement@finco.com please confirm and we can sign the pilot schedule and keep onboarding.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Legal & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 18:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Weekly leadership snapshot: priorities, blockers, and delegated actions (Feb 2)

Thanks — scheduling the capacity review now.

Quick operational notes to close the loop:
- Capacity headroom: with current pools we have ~12% headroom (consistent with the 88% Jonas reported). Two concurrent medium pilots would push us to ~6% headroom; we would start to see queueing for requests >1.2k tokens at p95.
- Mitigation options (short list):
  * Short-term: spin up one additional GPU node for 72 hours to cover expected peak (estimated cost: ~$3.2k/week).
  * Medium: accelerate the drift/eviction work to reclaim spot-able kernels (ETA 3 weeks).
  * Long: adjust autoscale thresholds for dedicated pools with a temporary reserve for strategic pilots.

Action items I will take:
- Run the 30-min review tomorrow 10:00 UTC with infra and ops (invite sent).
- Share a one-page mitigations summary after the meeting with cost and lead times (by Wed 12:00 UTC).

Vivek — I will highlight the short-term cost and recommend spin-up if we need to guarantee Acme onboarding.

Maya
Maya Srinivasan
GM, Infrastructure & Reliability
Redwood Inference
